selected_script.angle: Stop trying to clean sticky coffee splatter in a car cup holder with a dry napkin that shreds and leaves brown residue; use the Chemical Guys kit’s Total Interior Cleaner and blue microfiber towel for a cleaner same-spot interior detail.
selected_script.hook: I tried wiping this sticky cup holder mess with a napkin, and it just made little paper bits stick to it.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up inside a car cup holder with dried coffee rings and sticky brown splatter. A hand presses a dry fast-food napkin into the cup holder and rubs, but the napkin tears and leaves white paper fibers stuck in the residue.
timeline.3-6s: The same napkin keeps rubbing the same cup holder. The coffee residue smears wider along the plastic grooves, paper bits cling to the sticky spots, and the hand pauses with visible frustration from the extra mess.
timeline.6-10s: The Chemical Guys kit enters naturally beside the open car door, preserving the blue-white-black-gray camo bucket, circular Chemical Guys logo, multicolor bottles, green mitt, foam blaster, blue microfiber towels, applicators, wheel brush, and Dirt Trap proportions. The blue Total Interior Cleaner spray bottle and blue microfiber towel clean the same cup holder with realistic wiping pressure. Finish on a close before-after angle: one edge still shows the original sticky ring while the cleaned side looks matte, clear, and residue-free. Light spoken CTA: Check it out for your next car cleanup.
